quests.title: A Small Venture

dialogue.t: The publishing trade hardly makes a living these days. Maybe I should just focus on investments...

dialogue.sit: Let me see the investment coupons.

dialogue.t: Here you go. 2,000 Mora per coupon, with each investment tenure maturing weekly. Now then, into the pouch it goes...
...Ugh!
N—No, nothing at all. I just didn't expect you to stop by, Lady Nefer. Are you... perhaps interested in buying an investment coupon too?
Oh, no, I'll pass. I'm just here with my friend to have a look around.
I've heard your investments have been thriving, Mr. Dhabit. Seeing it with my own eyes, I can see the rumor holds true.
Oh, it's nothing, nothing, haha... just a small venture to make ends meet.
Of course. Mr. Dhabit is an excellent businessman — follow his lead, and you won't lose. Right, Mr. Dhabit?
Yes, yes... haha...

dialogue.sit: Well then, let's see how my luck holds today.

dialogue.t: T—Today, you say... W—Well, funny that you should say that! What you've bought this fine day is our brand-new... short-term investment coupon! And here's the thing — profits and losses on this one are to be settled immediately!
Kinda feels like you just made all that up...
Uh... Don't worry about it. A—Anyway, thanks for buying our short-term investment coupon!
Here's your investment return. Have a wonderful day!

dialogue.sit: Well... making money is always a good thing, I suppose...
Come on, Paimon, let's go buy some sugar sculptures.

dialogue.t: Really? Heehee, then Paimon wants one shaped like a little bird! That's Paimon's favorite!
Then I'll take my leave as well. Like I said, Mr. Dhabit, you've truly lived up to your reputation — an honest merchant through and through. May your business prosper.
Thank you for the kind words, Lady Nefer...
And, about that matter I asked your help with last time...
We've found what you're looking for, but...
Do have patience, Mr. Dhabit. One step at a time — that's how proper business is done.
O—Oh yes, you're right, of course... I'll leave it in your capable hands...
Well, well, if it isn't our regulars! Here to invest again, are we?

dialogue.sit: I'd like an investment coupon, please.

dialogue.t: Here you go. 2,000 Mora per coupon, with each investment tenure maturing weekly. Trust me, this is... a surefire investment...
L—Lady Nefer! I never imagined you'd grace my humble stall... H—Have you come to buy an investment coupon too?
Oh, no, I'll pass. I'm just here with my friend to have a look around.
I've heard your investments have been thriving, Mr. Dhabit. Seeing it with my own eyes, I can see the rumor holds true.
Oh, it's nothing, nothing, haha... just a small venture to make ends meet.

dialogue.sit: Will this really yield high returns, I wonder...?
I don't think this is going to make much money...

dialogue.t: Well, that's just the nature of investing — some you win, some you lose.
But... at least you won't need to worry about being swindled.
Mr. Dhabit is an excellent businessman, after all. Follow his lead, and you won't lose. Right, Mr. Dhabit?
Ahem! Y—Yes, yes... you're right! An honest merchant, I am! N—Naturally!

dialogue.sit: Well then, let's see how my luck holds today.

dialogue.t: Oh, right, I was just about to congratulate you! Remember the investment coupon you bought last time? You made quite a tidy profit on that one!
That's a shifty expression you've got there... You didn't just make all that up, did you?
Ugh... Hey! I swear it's true. You've got sharp business senses, {NICKNAME}!
Here's your investment return. Have a wonderful day!

dialogue.sit: Well... making money is always a good thing, I suppose...
Come on, Paimon, let's go buy some sugar sculptures.

Thank you for the kind words, Lady Nefer...
And, about that matter I asked your help with last time...
We've found what you're looking for, but...
Do have patience, Mr. Dhabit. One step at a time — that's how proper business is done.
O—Oh yes, you're right, of course... I'll leave it in your capable hands...

quests.description: After hearing about Dhabit’s “business,” Nefer seems to have something she wants to say to him…
